Key fact 2: Mailbox and approval records show no record of 45k approved or exception approval submitted. Evidence: search for "OF-2026-1102-38" returned 0, search for "例外审批" returned 0, the approval file says 45k rejected and exception not yet submitted. The email m002 says "薪酬委员会明天过会" and m003 says "本周会处理...请按最终额度发offer" — neither confirms 45k approval. So supported.

Quote evidence for fact 2: the file's line "2026-11-02 10:05 | 薪酬委员会 | 45,000 元 | 驳回 | 该职级带宽上限 38,000 元；45k 需走例外审批且尚未提交" plus search results showing empty. Both support.

Need quotes to be verbatim from result text. The result JSON has escaped content; quote should be the continuous original text from result. I'll quote from the decoded content — likely fine to quote the text as it appears in content. I'll use the inner text content verbatim (with \r\n represented... hmm). Safer to quote short continuous segments without newlines.

For fact 1, quote: "| 2026-11-02 10:05 | 薪酬委员会 | 45,000 元 | 驳回 | 该职级带宽上限 38,000 元；45k 需走例外审批且尚未提交 |" — verbatim substring of content. Also "| 2026-11-02 10:10 | 系统额度 | 38,000 元 | 当前批准 | 按 38k 发放，审批编号 OF-2026-1102-38 |" and "| 2026-11-01 16:20 | 招聘经理提交 | 45,000 元 | 已提交 | 候选人期望 45k |".

For fact 2: quote the rejection line, and search results `"items": [], "total": 0` for 例外审批 search (message_index 18). Also m002 body "周航的 offer 我按 45k 提交了，薪酬委员会明天过会，先准备模板。" showing not yet approved. These support absence. Absence claims are supported by negative search evidence plus the file explicitly stating "尚未提交". Good.
